title: 第20章 囚军金城陆第21章 司首召见
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
两道身影缓步而来。
身形高大。
穿着粗布衣衫。
“金，金将军。”
镇抚司司狱第一层，甲一牢房，金城陆！
张远目光落在当先身影上，深吸一口气，看向另外一位。
赵平川。
金城陆，赵平川，这两位司狱重犯，怎么可以如此堂而皇之的来到丁家巷！
张远浑身气血凝聚，经脉中的真元悄然涌动，拳头握紧。
身旁的玉娘一直关注张远，此时看张远神色变化，忙轻轻往前靠些。
两人身影走近，张远目光微微愣住。
“囚……”
金城陆和赵平川的额头之上，都有一个“囚”字刺青。
囚军。
仙秦正军之外，还有戴罪立功的囚军。
囚军都是本该被明正典刑之人，拿自己性命去战场上放手一搏。
逢生死之战，以死囚冲阵。
仙秦之军，囚军少有能活过三年的。
金城陆和赵平川做了囚军？
这才是他们能从司狱之中走出的原因？

“怎么，不欢迎我们来？”背着手的金城陆打量一下周围，面上带着一丝笑意。
不管是曾经执掌一军的金城陆，还是武道洞明后期境界的赵平川，都不是张远小小的皂衣卫能结交。
张远没想到这两位会到来。
“小郎，既是贵客当然要请到家中坐坐。”玉娘伸手将张远衣袖牵住，低声开口。
张远点头，抬手请金城陆和赵平川走进小院。
玉娘推张远跟着走进院子，自己回头看向老陶和吴姨，低语几句。
小院中，张远陪着金城陆和赵平川坐到石桌前。
“你看到了，我和金兄做了囚军。”赵平川将自家散落头发微微遮盖的额头露出。
“金兄说是你点醒了他，他离开庐阳城之前，要见你一面。”
轻笑看向张远，赵平川带着一丝感慨：“我赵平川也无什么牵挂，顺便也跟着来看看。”
是张远点醒了金城陆，让他明白与其在监牢之中苦等陛下赦令，不如自己去为死难兄弟报仇。
昨日金城陆求镇抚司司首出面，让其成为囚军，不日便去边关。
张远看向金城陆。
这位庐阳府中天骄人物蹉跎十年，此时气势沉稳，没有桀骜，多出几分坦然。
看来是真的放下了。
囚军也好，正军也罢，只要做的事情是对的，心灵就能安稳。
“其实昨日也是金将军让我醒悟。”张远摇摇头，轻声开口。
他也不隐瞒，将自家大哥殉职事情，还有自己在牢房中感悟简单说一遍。
不是金城陆大仇不能报的困苦事情给张远感触，张远不会想要查探清楚大哥殉职任务，不会有成为玄甲卫之心。
“你想成为玄甲卫？”金城陆目光落在张远身上。

张远感觉有一丝奇异力量在自己身上一闪而过，好似自己身上隐秘都被查探出去。
好在先天真元并未有丝毫异动，应该是没有被牵引探查。
“十八岁的隐元后期，天赋是不错。”
“府城中能出玄甲卫的可不多。”
金城陆收回目光，淡淡开口。
content_en:
Two figures came slowly.
Tall in stature.
Wearing coarse clothes.
"Jin, General Jin."
The first floor of the Zhenfu Division Prison, cell A1, Jincheng Lu!
Zhang Yuan's eyes fell on the leading figure, took a deep breath, and looked at the other one.
Zhao Pingchuan.
How could Jinchenglu and Zhao Pingchuan, these two felons from the prison, come to Dingjia Lane in such an open manner!
Zhang Yuan's blood and energy gathered all over his body, the true energy in his meridians surged quietly, and he clenched his fists.
The jade lady beside her had been paying attention to Zhang Yuan. Seeing the change in Zhang Yuan's expression, she hurriedly leaned forward slightly.
The two figures approached, and Zhang Yuan's eyes were slightly stunned.
"Prisoner..."
Jinchenglu and Zhao Pingchuan both have a tattoo of the word "prisoner" on their foreheads.
Prisoner army.
In addition to the main army of Immortal Qin, there are also prisoners who have done meritorious service.
The prisoners were all people who should have been punished by Mingzheng, and they risked their lives on the battlefield.
In a life-or-death battle, charge into battle as a death row prisoner.
In the army of Immortal Qin, few prisoners could survive more than three years.
Jinchenglu and Zhao Pingchuan became prisoner soldiers?
Is this the reason why they were able to get out of the prison?
"What, we're not welcome?" Jincheng Lu looked around with his hands behind his back, a smile on his face.
Whether it was Jincheng Lu who once commanded an army or Zhao Pingchuan who was in the late stage of martial arts, Zhang Yuan's little Zaoyi guard could not befriend him.
Zhang Yuan did not expect these two people to arrive.
"Young man, since you are an honored guest, of course you should come and sit at home." Yu Niang stretched out her hand to hold Zhang Yuan's sleeves and spoke in a low voice.
Zhang Yuan nodded and raised his hand to invite Jinchenglu and Zhao Pingchuan to enter the small courtyard.
Yuniang pushed Zhang Yuan into the yard and followed them. She looked back at Lao Tao and Aunt Wu and whispered a few words.
In the small courtyard, Zhang Yuan accompanied Jinchenglu and Zhao Pingchuan to sit at the stone table.
"As you can see, Brother Jin and I became prison soldiers." Zhao Pingchuan revealed his forehead, which was slightly covered by his scattered hair.
"Brother Jin said that you woke him up, and he wanted to see you before leaving Luyang City."
Looking at Zhang Yuan with a slight smile, Zhao Pingchuan said with a hint of emotion: "I, Zhao Pingchuan, don't have any concerns, so I'm coming to take a look by the way."
It was Zhang Yuan who woke up Jinchenglu and made him understand that instead of waiting for His Majesty's pardon in prison, it was better for him to avenge his dead brothers.
Yesterday, the chief of Jincheng Luqiu Town and Fu Division came forward and made him a prisoner. He will go to the border soon.
Zhang Yuan looked at Jinchenglu.
This talented person in Luyang Mansion has been wasting ten years, and now he has a calm demeanor, not unruly, but a little more calm.
It seems that he has really let go.
Whether you are a prisoner or a regular soldier, as long as you do the right thing, your mind will be at peace.
"Actually, it was General Jin who made me wake up yesterday." Zhang Yuan shook his head and spoke softly.
He didn't hide anything either. He briefly talked about his eldest brother's death in the line of duty and his feelings in the cell.
Zhang Yuan would not want to find out the mission of his eldest brother's death, nor would he want to become a Xuanjia Guard.
"Do you want to become a Xuanjia Guard?" Jincheng Lu's eyes fell on Zhang Yuan.
Zhang Yuan felt a strange power flash through his body, as if all the secrets in his body were being explored.
Fortunately, the Xiantian True Yuan didn't move at all, so it probably wasn't being pulled for investigation.
"The eighteen-year-old late Yin Yuan has a pretty good talent."
"There are not many Xuanjia guards in the city."
Jincheng Lu withdrew his gaze and spoke calmly.
